## Summary of Search Results

Fox Corporation announced that FOX One, a new direct-to-consumer streaming service, will launch on August 21 for $19.99 per month or $199.99 annually.

The service will offer cord-cutters and cord-nevers live streaming and on-demand access to FOX News Channel, FOX Business, FOX Weather, FOX Sports, FS1, FS2, FOX Deportes, B1G, FOX Local Stations and the FOX Network. FOX Nation and B1G+ will also be available as add-ons, with users able to bundle FOX One and FOX Nation for $24.99 per month or the equivalent of $19.99 per month with an annual plan.

The service will feature AI-powered personalization technologies that integrate live and video on-demand content.
